peristyle.line: A top-down 2D fantasy game map of a single circular tower chamber, seen from directly above in classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful textures and clean tile-like detailing, bright warm sunlight from above. The chamber is a perfect circle centred in the image and filling most of the frame. Its entire perimeter is a ring of warm honey-gold and terracotta sandstone columns joined by rounded arches, with a low carved balustrade running between every pair of columns. Two heavier dark slate-grey stone columns stand at the top centre of the ring. The floor inside the ring is a wide open sweep of warm cream flagstones, completely clear and empty, with a raised round stepped stone plinth at the exact centre, its top surface bare. A wide arched doorway breaks the ring at the bottom centre and a narrow stone stair opening breaks it at the top centre. EVERYTHING OUTSIDE THE CIRCULAR RING IS PLAIN FLAT SOLID PURE WHITE — the four corners of the image are pure white emptiness, and the openings between the columns and beneath the arches are pure white, with no sky, no clouds, no ground and no scenery of any kind beyond the stonework. Clean readable top-down shapes, soft painted shadows falling straight down.

brokencrown.line: A top-down 2D fantasy game map of a single circular tower chamber, seen from directly above in classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful textures and clean tile-like detailing, bright warm sunlight from above. The floor inside is a wide open sweep of pale grey flagstones, mostly clear and empty, with a raised round stepped stone plinth at the exact centre, its top surface bare. A wide arched doorway breaks the ring at the bottom centre and a narrow stone stair opening at the top centre. EVERYTHING OUTSIDE THE CIRCULAR RING IS PLAIN FLAT SOLID PURE WHITE — the four corners of the image are pure white emptiness, and every gap between the columns, every fallen arch and every opening is pure white, with no sky, no clouds, no ground and no scenery beyond the stonework. Clean readable top-down shapes, soft painted shadows falling straight down.

hall.line: A top-down 2D fantasy game map of an OPEN-AIR circular observatory terrace atop a tall tower, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted soft colourful texture, bright warm sunlight from above. THE TERRACE HAS NO OUTER WALL. Its edge is a ring of about fourteen separate free-standing indigo-blue and bronze columns spaced WIDE APART with large empty gaps between them, joined overhead by tall slender arches and at floor level only by a low carved balustrade. You see straight through every gap; it is open to the air on all sides. Two heavier dark slate-blue columns stand together at top centre. The floor is a magnificent inlaid mosaic of wide concentric bands — lapis-blue tile, cream marble, polished brass — radiating from the centre like an orrery, with engraved constellation lines and gold star studs; the bands are wide, clean, clear of objects. At the exact centre stands a LARGE raised circular pale-stone dais with three broad shallow steps up to it, ringed in brass, its flat top completely bare. A wide arched doorway breaks the ring at bottom centre; a narrow stair rises at top centre. EVERYTHING BEYOND THE COLUMNS IS PLAIN FLAT SOLID PURE WHITE, and every gap between columns and under every arch is that same PURE WHITE showing straight through, nothing at all beyond the stonework. The four image corners are pure white emptiness. Clean readable top-down shapes, soft shadows falling straight down onto the floor only.

free.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture. A single perfectly circular chamber at the top of a wizard's tower, floating alone in the middle of the image with clear white margin all around it so the whole circle fits inside the frame. Ring the edge with beautiful stone columns and arches of your own invention. Fill the floor with a spectacular decorative pattern of your own invention. At the exact centre place one large raised round dais, its flat top completely bare and empty. Everything beyond the building is plain flat solid pure white, and the gaps between the columns are pure white too. Be inventive and surprising with the architecture, the materials and the floor design.

floors.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map tile, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture. A single perfectly circular decorative FLOOR laid flat on the ground, centred in the image with clear white margin all around it. This is FLOOR ONLY - a flat paved surface and nothing else. No walls, no columns, no arches, no pedestal, no railings, no furniture and no objects of any kind stand on it. Keep the outer third of the circle calmer and simpler, in quiet mid-tone colours, so a character can stand there and read clearly; save the strongest pattern and colour for the middle. Nothing pure black and nothing pure white. Everything beyond the circle is plain flat solid pure white. The floor is a great moot-ground of split slate and hammered iron: heavy irregular grey flagstones bound by dark iron straps and rivets, with a deep-cut ring of tally marks and notched counting scores scored into the stone around the centre, stained rust-red in the grooves.

floors2.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map tile, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture. No walls, columns, arches, pedestal, railings, furniture, tents, or objects of any kind stand on it; everything is flat markings worn into the surface. Worn walking paths are trodden across it in a ring and toward the centre, so it clearly looks walked-on and lived-in. Keep the outer third calm and simple in quiet MID-TONE colours - not pale, not washed out, not bright - so a character standing there reads clearly; save the strongest pattern for the middle. Nothing pure black and nothing pure white. Everything beyond the circle is plain flat solid pure white. Heavy split slate bound with iron straps. Flat markings only: trodden dirt tracks worn pale through the stone, dark scorch rings where cook-fires burned, old bones and antler fragments trodden flat into the flags, and a deep-cut ring of tally scores stained rust-red around the centre.

floors3.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map tile, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture, bright and cheerful adventure-game mood. rings.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture, bright and cheerful adventure-game mood. A single perfectly circular open-air chamber at the top of a tall tower, floating alone in the middle of the image with generous white margin all around so the whole circle fits inside the frame. Its edge is a ring of about twelve tall free-standing columns spaced WIDE APART with big empty openings between them, arches overhead and a low balustrade at floor level; you see straight through every gap. The columns REPEAT in a calm regular rhythm - they are the quiet frame, not the subject. At the exact centre stands the hero of the image: a LARGE, tall, elaborate raised PEDESTAL, the single most detailed, brightest and most eye-catching thing in the picture, with a wide flat BARE empty top big enough to stand on. The plain floor between the columns and the pedestal is SIMPLE and undecorated. Everything beyond the columns, and every gap between them, is plain flat solid pure white. The columns are ancient trees grown into carved stone, bark and pale wood spiralling up into branching arches. The pedestal is a colossal golden stump-throne ringed with glowing amber sap and carved animal faces.

rings2.line: Top-down 2D fantasy game map, seen from directly above, classic Pokemon overworld style, hand-painted with soft colourful texture, bright cheerful adventure-game mood, rich saturated mid-tone colour with no bleached white or washed-out pale areas. A single perfectly circular open-air chamber at the top of a tall tower, alone in the middle of the image with generous white margin all around so the whole circle fits in frame. Its edge is a ring of twelve tall free-standing columns spaced WIDE APART with big empty openings between them and arches overhead; you see straight through every gap. The columns repeat in a calm regular rhythm - they are the quiet frame, not the subject. THE PEDESTAL AT THE CENTRE IS ENORMOUS: a broad circular stepped platform whose diameter is a FULL THIRD OF THE WIDTH OF THE WHOLE CHAMBER, rising on three wide steps, dominating the room and impossible to miss. Its flat top is COMPLETELY BARE AND EMPTY - no statue, no crystal, no ornament, no object stands on it. The plain floor between the columns and the pedestal is SIMPLE and undecorated. Everything beyond the columns, and every gap between them, is plain flat solid pure white, with no shadow cast outside the building. The columns are enormous faceted crystals in teal and violet glowing softly from within, with crystalline arches. The vast pedestal is pale stone banded in white and gold crystal, its wide bare top glowing faintly at the rim.

dais.line: A single fantasy game object alone in the centre of a completely plain flat pure white empty background - no room, no floor, no walls, no columns, no scenery, no shadow cast onto anything. Hand-painted 2D game art with soft colourful texture, rich saturated mid-tone colour, bright cheerful adventure-game mood, clean readable shapes. LOW TOP-DOWN VIEW like a classic Pokemon overworld object - the camera is above and tilted forward, so you clearly see BOTH the flat top surface as an ellipse AND the FRONT FACE of the object below it. The object is a grand raised circular PLATFORM - a wide stepped dais built to be STOOD ON. Its flat elliptical top is COMPLETELY BARE AND EMPTY: no statue, no crystal, no orb, no ornament, nothing on it at all. Three broad steps lead up the FRONT of it. All the carving and decoration is on the FRONT FACE, the step risers and the rim - the top stays plain, because a character will stand there. Wide and solid and low, not a tall pillar or a column. Warm honey sandstone banded with polished bronze, engraved star-glyphs and zodiac script running around the rim and step risers.
